methodology.source_assessed_values: DataSF: Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (wv5m-vpq2), closed_roll_year=2025
methodology.scope: Glen Park neighborhood, Single Family Residential only, pilot/sample
methodology.market_value_estimation: For each home, found the 5 geographically nearest 'comps' (homes in this same pull that sold in 2022 or later, so their assessed value is close to actual sale price under Prop 13's reset-at-sale rule). Took the median $/sqft among those comps and multiplied by the subject home's square footage. This ignores up to ~3 years of 2%/yr Prop 13 drift on the comps themselves and does not adjust for condition, view, or lot size beyond sqft/location -- a rough estimate, not an appraisal.
